values.en: If $H$ witnesses $f_0\simeq f_1$, then $(t,x)\mapsto g(H(t,x))$ is continuous as a composite, and has endpoints $g\circ f_0,g\circ f_1$. It is also Homotopy.comp of the constant homotopy of $g$ with $H$.
values.zh-CN: 若 $H$ 见证 $f_0\simeq f_1$，则 $(t,x)\mapsto g(H(t,x))$ 由复合连续性知联合连续，端点是 $g\circ f_0,g\circ f_1$。这也等于 $g$ 的恒等同伦与 $H$ 的 Homotopy.comp。
